# Getting help with w3Develops

- **Using the site** (accounts, groups, the feed): see the
  [FAQ](https://w3develops.org/faq), or ask on our
  [Discord](https://w3develops.org/chat).
- **Something's broken:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/w3develops/w3Develops/issues/new/choose)
  with the page, what you did, and what you expected.
- **Account or privacy questions:** use the
  [support form](https://w3develops.org/support) or email
  w3DevelopsSupport@googlegroups.com. Privacy requests can also go to
  privacy@w3develops.org.
- **A member or post breaking the Code of Conduct:** use **Report** on their
  profile or post. Moderators review every report.
- **A security problem:** please don't open a public issue. Follow
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **Contributing code or writing:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
